# `aitbc agent config-get`

Get configuration value or the full configuration for a named agent.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent config-get [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | yes | Agent name. |
| `--key` | text | — | no | Specific configuration key to retrieve |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent config-get --name <name>
```
